policy: Official picks use Hubáček gates: decorrelated model beats the de-vigged market by >= 2 pp, honest EV >= 2% (calibrated pre-decorrelation probability), and a per-bet-type confidence bar (20 pp moneyline, 10 pp baseball/soccer, 5 pp spread cover). Live thresholds live in web/hubacek_picks.py; per-league overrides (min_market_gap_pp, min_win_confidence_pp, min_ev_pct, ml_lo/ml_hi, allowed_sides, min_spread_cover_gap_pp, min_spread_confidence_pp, min_spread_point_edge) are stored here from walk-forward bet backtests.

mlb.note: MLB v2 (73 features: ISO/XBH, bullpen outs-5, SP FIP trend, elo momentum) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_mlb_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 6 pp (6.7 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -200..+200. Opening-line ROI +34.3% (2024-2026, CLV +21.8%); closing-line floor -2.2%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between those brackets.

nba.note: NBA v2 (89 features: team four-factors + schedule/context + player minutes/usage/AST-TOV/DNP/bench proxies) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nba_bets.py): market-aware margin model cover gap >= 10 pp at the opening spread. Opening-line ROI +24.6% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (2024-2026, 627 bets, worst-season +15.3%). Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

wnba.note: WNBA v2 (66 features; OOS LL 0.62462) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_wnba_bets.py): pure margin model cover probability vs the juice-implied break-even. Live Hubáček gate in this file stays at 8 pp cover gap with a 5 pp confidence floor (prior open-line backtest at that gate: +5.2% ROI / 321 bets). data/models/wnba_v2/bet_policy.json may use a different grid for research (e.g. 12 pp) — that is not the live site gate and its ROI should not be treated as the live policy. Retrain improved OOS logloss; morning bets sit between open and close.

cbb.note: Official tracking stays disabled. CBBGradientBoost v2 ships with PIT-safe ESPN walk-forward features (OOS logloss ~0.507 vs ensemble ~0.55 gate) and Torvik as live fallback only — not used in training. ESPN core closing odds now cover 2024-11-04→2025-03-15 (6164 games, 5636 with odds in data/supplemental/closing-odds/cbb.csv). Expand with: python scripts/fetch_cbb_odds.py --start-season 2024 --end-season 2026 (merge-safe; or --start-date/--end-date chunks). Enable picks only after remaining seasons are filled plus a positive worst-season spread backtest.

nfl.note: NFLGradientBoost v2 is live for predictions (63 features: team Elo/EWMA + QB/coach Elo + rest/weather/roof/div context; OOS margin MAE 10.41 beats nfelo 10.69). Official picks stay disabled: close-only Hubacek sweep still has negative worst-season ROI (best about -12.6%). nflverse has no opening lines. Gate parameters kept for reference only.

cfb.note: CFBGradientBoost v2 is live for predictions (48 features; OOS margin MAE 13.75 beats Elo 14.15, logloss 0.534 vs Elo 0.560). Official picks stay disabled: best spread policy worst-season ROI remains negative (~-5%). Gate parameters kept for reference only.

nhl.note: NHL v2 (88 features: flurry/rebound xG, PP/PK ice, goalie HD GSAx, schedule density) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nhl_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 7 pp (7.8 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -350..+300. Opening-line ROI +9.4% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (CLV +3.95%); closing-line 12-season ROI +6.1%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

epl.note: Soccer v2 pooled top-5 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_soccer_bets.py): market-aware calibrated home prob beats the devigged opening line by >= 4 pp raw (4.6 pp after 1.15x decorrelation), EV >= 5% — home outcomes only (draw/away legs were not profitable). Best-price execution ROI +4.3% across 2015-2025 with 10/11 seasons positive, CLV +4.0% (65% positive-CLV bets).
